posts.question: Under the ADA, when can an employer first require a medical exam?
options: Only after 90 days on the job
posts.explain: Before an offer, medical exams are off-limits. After a conditional offer, an employer may require one if everyone entering the same job category gets it.

✅ Answer: B. After a conditional job offer.
The ADA bars medical exams before an offer. Once a conditional offer is made, an employer may require one, as long as everyone entering the same job category gets it and the results are kept confidential.

posts.alt_q:
SHRM-CP & SCP Question of the Day: Under the ADA, when can an employer first require a medical exam?
A. Before the first interview
B. After a conditional job offer
C. Only after 90 days on the job
D. Never, for any job
posts.alt_a: Answer: B. After a conditional job offer. Before an offer, medical exams are off-limits. After a conditional offer, an employer may require one if everyone entering the same job category gets it.

youtube_quiz.question: Under the ADA, when can an employer first require a medical exam?
options: Only after 90 days on the job
youtube_quiz.explanation: The ADA bars pre-offer medical exams. After a conditional offer, one may be required if all entering employees in that job category get it.

sources: EEOC: Preemployment disability-related questions and medical exams
